title: Offline-first: write locally first, tell the user afterwards

videos.script:
Press save on a train, and one of two things happens. {{spinner}} The button spins until it gives up. Or the session is on the screen at once, and the app sends it later. {{list}}

The difference is where the truth lives while you use the app. {{two}} Online-first asks the server for every screen. Offline-first reads every screen from the database on the phone, and talks to the server as a separate step.

Today the planner becomes offline-first. {{write}} Every change goes to the local database. Every row carries one more fact: whether the server has it yet. {{states}} Pending, synced, or failed.

And the hard part is the last one. {{failed}} A session the server refuses an hour after you typed it. The app keeps it, and tells you which one, and why.
